description: This file defines a NoteMapper class responsible for converting between Note objects and database row representations, facilitating data persistence and retrieval.

classes.name: NoteMapper
classes.description: Provides static methods to map Note objects to database rows and vice versa.

methods.name: fromRow
methods.description: Converts a database row (Map<String, Object?>) into a Note object.

methods.name: toRow
methods.description: Converts a Note object into a Map<String, Object?> suitable for database storage.
